title: Scripts are assigned to All Devices or All Users

messages.businessImpact: Code runs everywhere with no pilot, so a mistake affects every device before anyone can see it happening.
remediation: Target a pilot group first and widen after the results are checked.
messages.cannotSee: Targeting the whole estate is sometimes right: a script that collects an inventory or sets one harmless value belongs everywhere, and this reports it beside one that does not. Assignment filters narrow what a built-in target reaches and are not read into this judgement, so an assignment carrying one is reported as though it reached everybody. What the script does is not considered at all.
